name: Rot18withcasepreservation

description_json.name: Rot18WithCasePreservation
description_json.idea: A highly intuitive, dual-domain Caesar-style cipher. Alphabetic characters are rotated by 13 positions (ROT13), preserving case. Numeric digits (0-9) are rotated by 5 positions (ROT5). Non-alphanumeric characters (spaces, punctuation) remain completely unchanged. This provides a clean, uniform transformation across both letters and numbers that is extremely easy for LLMs to reason about.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the input string:
1. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it by 13 positions: encrypt(char) = chr(((ord(char) - 65 + 13) % 26) + 65).
2. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it by 13 positions: encrypt(char) = chr(((ord(char) - 97 + 13) % 26) + 97).
3. If it is a digit (0-9), shift it by 5 positions: encrypt(char) = chr(((ord(char) - 48 + 5) % 10) + 48).
4. If it is any other character (space, punctuation, etc.), leave it completely unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
For each character in the input string:
1. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it back by 13 positions: decrypt(char) = chr(((ord(char) - 65 - 13) % 26) + 65).
2. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it back by 13 positions: decrypt(char) = chr(((ord(char) - 97 - 13) % 26) + 97).
3. If it is a digit (0-9), shift it back by 5 positions: decrypt(char) = chr(((ord(char) - 48 - 5) % 10) + 48).
4. If it is any other character (space, punctuation, etc.), leave it completely unchanged.
